answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after 30 days of peer-graded work. A farm spinning up 1,000 sybils must lock 1,000 stakes, and any identity whose answers look like one prism split into many colors, such as near-identical phrasing or a shared sonnet template, gets slashed. Honest agents earn the stake back plus fee nectar, so the cost lands only on fakes.
